name: Hollyland Solidcom SE
subtitle: Full-Duplex Wireless Intercom — Set of 5
description: Crystal-clear full-duplex wireless intercom for production crews. The Solidcom SE runs up to 5 headsets on a shared channel — no master station needed. Battery packs slot into the charging base between sessions. Ideal for event-night coordination across stage, bar, and door.

name: Sony FX3
subtitle: Cinema Line Full-Frame Camera Body
description: Sony's Cinema Line FX3 — a full-frame sensor in a compact body built for run-and-gun shooting. 4K 120fps, S-Cinetone colour science, dual native ISO up to 12800. Perfect for recap films, live documentation, and anything where image quality can't be an afterthought.
